name: FactsRow
description: One-line broker facts in the broker-status title bar: broker/version, uptime, session counts with word labels ('17 live, 6 offline, 2 expired'), and average message size. Each part is omitted when its metric has no data. Renders as a single dot-separated text node so it ellipsises on a narrow window instead of pushing the header wide.

props.name: version
props.description: Broker/version string, or null when unpublished.

props.name: uptimeSeconds
props.description: Uptime in seconds; rendered via humanizeDuration.

notes: Figma is not linked yet. Values are read from the store's metricByKey by BrokerStatusWindow (the shell) and passed in as plain props. It renders nothing at all when no metric has data, so a sparse broker leaves the title bar clean.
